item.title: Tensions at Kamareddy MLA’s office amid clashes
item.description: Tensions erupted at the camp office of Kamareddy MLA Venkataramana Reddy when former sarpanch and Congress leader Giri Reddy Mahender Reddy arrived and chanted slogans such as "MLA down down". The police subsequently detained him.In the aftermath, BJP workers vandalised Mahender Reddy’s car and clashed with police who attempted to prevent their actions. The incident caused a stir in the area amid heightened tensions.

item.title: Sugar-free? Really?
item.description: To influence our psyche, many companies and even individual bakers use the term “sugar-free” — which often only means no refined white sugar. Instead, they add other processed or artificial sweeteners, some of which may be just as harmful, or even worse, than sugar itself. There’s a reason they’re called artificial sweeteners.
